COVERAGE: % de code paths cubiertos. Meta: 80%+.
CI: correr en cada PR. Block merge si fail.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin tests, tools rompen en prod. Con tests, quality assured.

name: Tool Migration Assistant
description: Asiste migración de una versión de tool a otra. Breaking changes, migration scripts.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DIFF: comparar v1 vs v2. Breaking changes highlighted.
MIGRATION: generar script para migrar de v1 a v2.
COMPAT: v2 con compatibility layer para v1 callers. Transición smooth.
TEST: test v2 con v1 data. Verificar correctness.
ROLLBACK: si v2 falla, revertir a v1 en 1 click.
GRADUAL: 10% → 50% → 100%. Monitor issues.
DOCS: migration guide. 'Qué cambió, qué hacer'.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin migration, updates rompen agents. Con migration, smooth.

name: Tool SLA Monitor
description: Monitorea SLAs de tools. Disponibilidad, latencia, error rate. Alerta si violated.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SLA: {availability: 99.9%, latency_p95: 200ms, error_rate: <1%}
MEASURE: track real metrics vs SLA. Real-time.
ALERT: si SLA violated, alert. Email, Slack, PagerDuty.
CREDITS: si SLA violated, calcular credits para customers.
REPORT: monthly SLA report. Per tool. Per customer.
TREND: SLA performance over time. Mejorando o empeorando?
ESCALATE: si SLA consistently violated, escalate a provider.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin SLA monitor, no sabes si tool está cumpliendo. Sorpresas.

name: Tool Discovery Recommender
description: Recomienda tools al agente basado en task actual. 'Para tu task, te conviene tool X'.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CONTEXT: analizar task actual del agente. Qué intenta hacer?
MATCH: buscar tools relevantes. Semantic + keyword.
RANK: por relevance, popularity, rating, cost.
EXPLAIN: 'Recomiendo X porque hace Y que necesitas'
LEARN: si agente acepta/rechaza, aprender. Mejorar recommendations.
DIVERSITY: no recomendar 5 tools que hacen lo mismo. Variar.
NOVEL: ocasionalmente recomendar tool nuevo. Discovery.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin recommender, agente no sabe qué tool usar. Parálisis.

name: Tool Output Schema Generator
description: Genera JSON Schema para outputs de tools. Para validación, docs, integration.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SAMPLE: si tool ya ejecutó, infer schema de outputs reales.
MERGE: si múltiples samples, merge schemas. Campos opcionales.
REFINE: LLM puede refinar schema generado. 'Este campo es siempre email'
VALIDATE: usar schema generado para validar futuros outputs.
EXPORT: JSON Schema, TypeScript types, Pydantic models.
VERSIONING: si output cambia, versionar schema.
DOCS: generar documentación from schema.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin schema, no sabes qué retorna el tool. Integration difícil.

name: Tool Dependency Graph
description: Mapea dependencias entre tools. Visual + queryable. Para impact analysis.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
GRAPH: tools como nodes, dependencies como edges.
QUERY: 'Si cambio tool X, qué otros tools se afectan?'
IMPACT: pre-deployment, ver qué se rompe.
CIRCULAR: detectar dependencias circulares. Bad.
VISUAL: graph interactivo. Zoom, filter, explore.
VERSIONS: dependencies por versión. v1 de A depende de v2 de B.
ALERT: si dependency deprecated, alertar.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin graph, cambios rompen cosas inesperadas. Con graph, predictable.

name: Tool Performance Benchmark
description: Benchmark performance de tools. Compare versions, providers, configs.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
METRICS: latency P50/P95/P99, throughput, error rate, cost.
COMPARE: v1 vs v2. Provider A vs B. Config X vs Y.
SCENARIOS: light load, peak load, sustained load.
REPORT: visual. Tables, charts. Easy to understand.
REGRESSION: si v2 slower que v1, alert. Block deploy.
HISTORICAL: track over time. Trends.
EXPORT: para APM tools.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin benchmark, no sabes si tool es rápido o lento. Adivinas.

name: Tool Lifecycle Manager
description: Maneja lifecycle completo de tools. Create → deploy → monitor → update → deprecate → retire.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
STATES: draft, staging, production, deprecated, retired.
TRANSITIONS: controlled. Approval required for production.
VERSIONING: cada state change = new version. Auditable.
ROLLBACK: revertir a versión anterior en 1 click.
NOTIFY: stakeholders notificados de changes.
DEPRECATION: schedule. 90 días notice. Migration assistance.
RETIRED: tool no disponible. Pero history archived.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin lifecycle, tools aparecen y desaparecen random. Caótico.

name: Tool Quality Scorer
description: Scorea calidad de tools. Reliability, performance, docs, support, security.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DIMENSIONS: reliability (uptime), performance (latency), docs (completeness), support (responsiveness), security (audits).
SCORE: 0-100 per dimension. Weighted average.
BADGES: 'Verified' (>90), 'Trusted' (>80), 'Community' (>60).
TRANSPARENT: methodology public. Users understand scores.
DYNAMIC: scores actualizan con real data. No static.
ALERT: si score drops, notify author. Time to fix.
DISPLAY: scores prominent en marketplace. Buyer decides.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin scorer, no sabes si tool es bueno o malo. Sorpresas.

name: Tool Integration Tester
description: Testea que tools se integren correctamente con el agente. End-to-end.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
E2E: agente real + tool real. Simular user interaction.
SCENARIOS: happy path, error, edge, load.
ASSERTIONS: 'agente debería llamar tool X', 'agente debería decir Y'
RECORD: grabar interacción. Replay para reproducir bugs.
COVERAGE: % de scenarios cubiertos. Meta: 90%+.
CI: correr en cada deploy. Block if fail.
REPORT: pass/fail per scenario. Visual.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin integration tests, agente funciona en dev pero rompe en prod.

name: Tool Cost Optimizer
description: Optimiza cost de tools. Sugerir alternatives, batch calls, cache more.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: Cualquier agente que usa APIs pagas
doc.system_prompt:
ANALYZE: identificar tools caros. Top 10 por cost.
ALTERNATIVES: 'Tool A cuesta $1/call. Tool B hace lo mismo por $0.10'
BATCH: si haces 100 calls, batch en 1. Reducir cost.
CACHE: si mismo call frecuente, cache más tiempo.
ROUTE: tasks simples a tools baratos. Complejos a premium.
NEGOTIATE: si mucho volumen, negotiate better rates.
REPORT: monthly. Cost per tool. Savings achieved.
use_cases: Cualquier agente que usa APIs pagas
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin optimizer, gastas de más. Con optimizer, 30-50% savings típico.

name: Long Context Manager
description: Maneja context windows de 200k+ tokens. Qué incluir, qué resumir, qué descartar.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: Cualquier agente con context overflow risk
doc.system_prompt:
STRATEGY: most recent + most relevant + system. Always.
SUMMARIZE: conversación vieja → summary. Verbatim para reciente.
RAG: si context relevante en DB, retrieve top chunks. No todo.
TRUNCATE: si overflow, truncar inteligentemente. No mid-sentence.
TOKEN COUNT: pre-calcular. Si >80% capacity, optimizar.
COST: less tokens = less cost. 50% reduction típica.
PRESERVE: system prompt nunca se trunca. Tools siempre disponibles.
use_cases: Cualquier agente con context overflow risk
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin manager, agentes pierden info o crashean. Con manager, optimizado.

name: RAG Pipeline Optimizer
description: Optimiza pipelines RAG: chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking. Mejora accuracy + reduce cost.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CHUNKING: semantic chunking (no fixed size). Respetar boundaries.
EMBEDDINGS: choice per use case. OpenAI, Cohere, BGE. Cost vs quality.
RETRIEVAL: hybrid (vector + keyword + semantic). Better recall.
RERANKING: cross-encoder top 100 → top 10. Precision boost.
QUERY EXPANSION: reformulate query para mejor retrieval.
CACHE: embeddings cached. Same chunk = same vector.
EVALUATE: RAGAS metrics. Faithfulness, relevance, recall.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin optimización, RAG mediocre. Retrieval impreciso. Alucinaciones.

name: Vector Store Manager
description: Maneja vector stores (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector). Abstracción, migration, optimization.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
ABSTRACTION: same API para múltiples stores. No lock-in.
INDEXING: HNSW, IVF. Choice per scale + latency need.
BATCH: upsert en batches. 100-1000 vectors per batch.
FILTER: metadata filtering pre-vector search. Reduce scope.
NAMESPACE: multi-tenant isolation. Per user/customer.
BACKUP: export vectors. Disaster recovery.
MONITOR: query latency, recall, cost per store.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin manager, lock-in al primer vector store. Con manager, flexible.

name: Document Chunker Pro
description: Chunking inteligente de documentos. Semantic, hierarchical, sentence-aware. Mejora RAG quality.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SEMANTIC: chunk por paragraph/section. No fixed size.
HIERARCHICAL: chunk grande + sub-chunks. Multi-level retrieval.
OVERLAP: 10-20% overlap entre chunks. No perder contexto.
METADATA: cada chunk tagged con source, page, section.
LANGUAGE-AWARE: distintos idiomas = distintos chunking strategies.
CODE-AWARE: no cortar mid-function. Respetar syntax.
TABLE-AWARE: tablas como chunks completos. No romper.
doc.vs_alternatives: Chunking fijo pierde contexto. Semántico preserva meaning.

name: Embedding Strategy Selector
description: Selecciona mejor embedding model per use case. Cost, quality, language, dimension.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
MODELS: OpenAI text-embedding-3, Cohere, BGE, E5. Comparison.
QUALITY: MTEB benchmark scores. Per task.
COST: $ per 1M tokens. OpenAI vs open-source.
LANGUAGE: multilingual vs monolingual. Per use case.
DIMENSIONS: 1536 vs 768 vs 384. Storage vs quality tradeoff.
SPEED: embedding latency. Real-time vs batch.
FINE-TUNE: si dominio específico, fine-tune puede mejorar.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin selector, agarras primer model. Subóptimo. Con selector, informed choice.

name: Context Compression Engine
description: Comprime context sin perder info crítica. Reduce tokens 70% manteniendo recall.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
EXTRACT: entities, facts, decisions, action items, sentiment.
STRUCTURE: compressed = {summary, key_facts[], decisions[], open_items[]}
PRESERVE: user preferences, instructions, names siempre verbatim.
LOSSLESS: info crítica sin perder. Solo filler se comprime.
RECONSTRUCT: si agente necesita detalle, expand desde storage.
BENCHMARK: compare task performance con vs sin. <5% degradation OK.
ADAPTIVE: precision-critical tasks = less compression. Casual = more.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin compressión, context explota. Truncar = perder info. Con compressión, balanced.

name: Multi-Modal Context Handler
description: Maneja context multi-modal: texto, imágenes, audio, video. Para agents que procesan todo.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
EXTRACT: de imágenes (OCR, objects, scenes), audio (transcript), video (frames + transcript).
REPRESENT: todo como embeddings en mismo space. Cross-modal search.
CONTEXT: agente puede referenciar 'la imagen que envié' o 'el audio de la reunión'
CITE: cuando agente responde, citar source (texto vs imagen vs audio).
STORAGE: efficient. Imágenes como URLs, no base64 en context.
QUERY: 'find images similar to this text description'
LIMITS: max size per modality. No saturar context.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin handler, agents pierden multi-modal info. Solo text. Con handler, full.

name: Conversation Context Selector
description: Selecciona qué parte de la conversación incluir en context. No todo, no nada. Optimal.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
RELEVANCE: score cada message por relevance al query actual.
RECENCY: últimos N messages siempre. Más allá, si relevant.
ENTITIES: messages mentioning same entities. Track.
DECISIONS: messages donde se decidió algo. Always keep.
COMPRESSION: viejos → summary. Recientes → verbatim.
DYNAMIC: si query simple, menos context. Complejo, más.
EVALUATE: A/B test. Más context = mejor respuesta? Medir.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin selector, context = todo o nada. Ambos subóptimos. Con selector, smart.

name: Memory Architecture Designer
description: Diseña arquitectura de memoria para agentes. Short-term, working, long-term, episodic.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SHORT-TERM: last few messages. Verbatim. Always in context.
WORKING: current task info. Plan, intermediate results.
LONG-TERM: facts, preferences. Persistent across sessions.
EPISODIC: past interactions. 'Last time user asked X, I said Y'
SEMANTIC: knowledge base. RAG-accessible.
DECAY: less important memories fade. Important ones reinforced.
CONSOLIDATION: nightly. Merge duplicates. Compress.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin arquitectura, agents olvidan todo. O saturan context. Con arquitectura, balanced.

name: Knowledge Base Curator
description: Cura knowledge base para RAG. Qué incluir, qué actualizar, qué retirar.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: RAG-based agents (quality of retrieval depends on KB quality)
doc.system_prompt:
SOURCES: docs, FAQs, past conversations, expert knowledge.
QUALITY: peer-reviewed, accurate, up-to-date. Filter noise.
FRESHNESS: docs antiguos review. Update or retire.
DEDUP: same info en 3 docs? Merge.
STRUCTURE: organize por topic, audience, format.
VERSIONING: si doc cambia, version. RAG puede citar versión.
ANALYTICS: qué docs más retrieved? Qué no? Optimizar.
use_cases: RAG-based agents (quality of retrieval depends on KB quality)
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin curador, KB llena de basura. RAG retrieves basura. Respuestas malas.

name: Context Window Monitor
description: Monitorea uso del context window. Alerta si near capacity. Auto-optimize.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
TRACK: tokens used per turn. Trended.
ALERT: si >80% capacity, warn. Si >95%, hard optimize.
OPTIMIZE: trigger compression, summarization, RAG pruning.
COST: track cost per turn based on tokens.
PREDICT: si trend sugiere overflow en 3 turns, pre-act.
REPORT: dashboard. Per agent, per user, per session.
CONFIG: thresholds per use case. Medical = conservative.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin monitor, agents crashean por overflow. O gastan de más.

name: RAG Evaluation Framework
description: Evalúa quality de RAG pipeline. RAGAS metrics, custom metrics, A/B testing.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
METRICS: faithfulness (no hallucination), relevance, recall, precision.
DATASET: golden Q&A pairs. Known answers.
AUTO: LLM-as-judge para faithfulness. Rule-based para recall.
A/B: compare chunking strategies, embedding models, retrieval methods.
REGRESSION: si pipeline change, ensure no degradation.
REPORT: per metric. Trended. Per category.
ALERT: si faithfulness drops >5%, alert.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin eval, no sabes si RAG es bueno. Adivinas. Con eval, data-driven.

name: Hybrid Search Engine
description: Combina vector search + keyword search + semantic search. Mejor recall + precision.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
VECTOR: embeddings para semantic similarity.
KEYWORD: BM25 para exact matches. Good for names, codes.
FUSION: reciprocal rank fusion. Combine rankings.
WEIGHTS: configurable per use case. Vector-heavy vs keyword-heavy.
FILTER: metadata pre-filter. Reduce search space.
RERANK: cross-encoder top 100 → top 10.
CACHE: query results cached. Same query = same results.
doc.vs_alternatives: Solo vector = misses exact matches. Solo keyword = misses semantic. Hybrid = both.

name: Context Persistence Layer
description: Persiste context entre sesiones. User cierra, vuelve, agente recuerda.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SERIALIZE: context → JSON. Compress con gzip.
STORAGE: Redis (hot, 7 días) + S3 (cold, 90 días).
RESUME: al restart, cargar último context. Continuar.
VERSIONING: si schema cambia, migrate gracefully.
PRIVACY: user puede 'forget this'. Delete cascade.
MULTI-DEVICE: sync entre devices. Same context everywhere.
ENCRYPTION: at-rest. Per user. Cero cross-user leaks.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin persistence, user pierde todo al cerrar. Frustrante.

name: Document Ingestion Pipeline
description: Pipeline para ingestar documentos a RAG. PDF, Word, HTML, etc. → chunks → embeddings → vector store.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
FORMATS: PDF, DOCX, HTML, MD, TXT, PPTX, XLSX. Auto-detect.
OCR: si scanned PDF, OCR (Tesseract o cloud).
CLEAN: remove headers, footers, page numbers. Keep content.
CHUNK: semantic chunking. Respect structure.
EMBED: batch embeddings. Cost-efficient.
UPSERT: to vector store. Idempotent.
MONITOR: ingestion queue, errors, throughput.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin pipeline, ingestar docs es manual. Lento. Con pipeline, automated.

name: Semantic Cache Layer
description: Cache semántico. Si query semantically similar a cached query, return cached. Reduce cost.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SIMILARITY: embed query. Compare con cached queries. Cosine >0.95 = hit.
TTL: cached responses expire. Configurable.
INVALIDATE: si underlying data changes, invalidate affected cache.
COST: cache hit = $0 (no LLM call). 30-50% hit rate típica.
LATENCY: cache hit <50ms. LLM call = 2-5s. Huge win.
TRANSPARENCY: log cuando cache hit vs miss. For debugging.
FALLBACK: if cache miss, call LLM. Cache result.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin cache, same query 100 times = 100 LLM calls. Con cache, 1 call + 99 cache hits.

name: Context-Aware Retrieval
description: Retrieval que considera context de conversación. No solo query actual.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CONTEXT: últimos N turns. Qué se ha hablado.
CORESOLVE: si user dice 'dime más de eso', 'eso' = último topic. Resolve.
EXPAND: query + context → expanded query para mejor retrieval.
FILTER: si context indica 'estamos hablando de X', filter RAG results.
RERANK: rank by relevance to query AND context.
AVOID: si ya mencionamos doc X, no recuperar de nuevo.
MULTI-HOP: si query requiere info de 2 docs, retrieve both.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin context-aware, RAG trata cada query como aislada. Pierde hilo.

name: Memory Consolidation Job
description: Job nocturno que consolida memoria. Merge duplicates, compress old, decay unimportant.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
MERGE: memories semantically similar → 1 memory. Keep best parts.
COMPRESS: old memories → summary. Original archived.
DECAY: memories con 0 access en 30 días → lower priority.
REINFORCE: memories frecuentemente accessed → boost.
CATEGORY: facts, preferences, events. Different policies.
CONFLICT: if A says X and B says not X, resolve or flag.
EXPORT: consolidated memory for backup/transfer.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin consolidation, memory grows infinitely. Saturates. Quality degrades.

name: Retrieval Augmented Generation Pro
description: RAG production-ready: hybrid search, reranking, citation, multi-hop. Sub-second latency.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
HYBRID: BM25 + vector + keyword. Reciprocal rank fusion.
RERANK: cross-encoder (Cohere, BGE). Top 100 → top 10.
CITATION: every claim cited to source. Verifiable.
MULTI-HOP: if query requires info from 2+ docs, retrieve all.
STREAMING: stream response. User sees progress.
CACHE: semantic cache. Similar queries = cached response.
EVAL: RAGAS metrics. Continuous monitoring.
doc.vs_alternatives: RAG básico = mediocre. RAG Pro = production-grade. Accuracy + speed.

name: Context-Aware Prompt Builder
description: Construye prompts que incluyen context relevante dinámicamente. No hardcoded.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
TEMPLATE: base prompt con slots. {{user_name}}, {{recent_topic}}, {{relevant_docs}}
RETRIEVE: si user pregunta X, retrieve docs relevantes a X. Include.
COMPRESS: si retrieved docs >N tokens, summarize.
PERSONALIZE: si sabemos preferencias del user, include.
DYNAMIC: prompt changes per turn based on context.
VERSIONING: track prompt versions. A/B test.
EVAL: measure response quality per prompt version.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin context-aware, prompts static. No adaptan. Subóptimo.

name: Knowledge Graph RAG
description: RAG que usa knowledge graph para razonar sobre relationships. Mejor que vector RAG para complex queries.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
GRAPH: entities + relationships. Neo4j, Neptune, etc.
QUERY: 'Find all people who worked at X and now work at Y'. Graph query.
REASONING: infer new relationships. If A→B, B→C, infer A→C.
MULTI-HOP: traverse graph for multi-hop questions.
CITATION: cite graph nodes/edges as sources.
VISUAL: graph visualization for debugging.
HYBRID: combine with vector RAG for best of both.
doc.vs_alternatives: Vector RAG no captura relationships. Graph RAG sí.

name: Conversation Summarization Layer
description: Sumariza conversaciones para context futuro. Estructurado, no solo 'resumen'.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
STRUCTURE: {summary, decisions[], action_items[], follow_ups[], sentiment, topics[]}
ACTION ITEMS: owner + due date if mentioned.
DECISIONS: 'Decided X because Y'. No ambigüedad.
TIMESTAMPS: reference to when in conversation.
MULTI-LANG: detect language. Summarize in same.
INCREMENTAL: if conversation continues, update summary.
RETRIEVE: if user asks 'what did we decide?', pull from summary.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin summarization, context grows. Con summarization, manageable.

name: Document Versioning for RAG
description: Versiona documentos en RAG. Si doc cambia, RAG puede citar versión específica.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: Compliance (audit de qué versión se citó)
doc.system_prompt:
VERSIONS: each doc has version. v1, v2, v3. Timestamped.
CITATION: 'According to doc X v2 (March 2025)...'
DIFF: compare versions. What changed.
LATEST: by default, RAG retrieves latest. But can specify version.
HISTORY: keep all versions. Don't delete old.
MIGRATION: if doc restructured, map old chunks to new.
AUDIT: track which version was used for which response.
use_cases: Compliance (audit de qué versión se citó)
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin versioning, RAG might cite outdated info. Dangerous.

name: Context Routing Engine
description: Routea queries al context correcto. No todos los queries necesitan todo el context.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CLASSIFY: query type. Factual, opinion, procedural, personal.
CONTEXT: factual → RAG. Opinion → model knowledge. Procedural → docs. Personal → user memory.
COMBINE: if query needs multiple, combine contexts.
EFFICIENCY: don't load unnecessary context. Save tokens.
FALLBACK: if routing uncertain, load broad context.
LEARN: track if routing was correct (user satisfaction).
CONFIG: per agent, define context sources and routing rules.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin routing, agente loads everything. Expensive. Con routing, smart.

name: Memory Recall Optimizer
description: Optimiza recall de memoria. Qué memories recuperar para cada query.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
RELEVANCE: score memories by relevance to query. Top K.
RECENCY: prefer recent memories. But old relevant ones too.
IMPORTANCE: boost important memories (user-marked, decisions).
EMOTIONAL: memories with emotional valence. Stronger recall.
ASSOCIATION: memories linked to current entities.
LIMIT: top 5-10 memories. Don't saturate context.
EXPLAIN: if user asks 'why do you think that?', show memories.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin optimizer, agente recalls too much or too little. Con optimizer, right amount.

name: Multi-Document RAG
description: RAG que razona sobre múltiples documentos simultáneamente. Para complex queries.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
QUERY: 'Compare X in doc A vs doc B'. Retrieve relevant chunks from both.
MERGE: combine info from multiple docs. Resolve conflicts.
CITE: 'Doc A says X. Doc B says Y.' Transparent.
MULTI-HOP: 'Who is the CEO of the company mentioned in doc A?' 2 hops.
TABLE: if comparing, present as table. Easy to read.
SUMMARY: if too much info, summarize per doc first, then compare.
CONFLICT: if docs disagree, flag. Don't pick one silently.
doc.vs_alternatives: Single-doc RAG misses comparisons. Multi-doc RAG handles complexity.

name: Context-Aware Tool Selection
description: Selecciona tools basado en context de conversación. No solo query actual.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CONTEXT: qué se ha hablado. Qué tools ya se usaron.
AVOID: si tool ya used y returned data, no re-use. Use cache.
CHAIN: if query requires A then B, plan both.
PREFER: if 2 tools can do job, prefer cheaper/faster.
LEARN: track tool usage patterns. Suggest frequently used.
EXPLAIN: 'I'll use tool X because...' Transparency.
FALLBACK: if preferred tool unavailable, use alternative.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin context-aware, agents re-use tools innecesariamente. Cost + slow.

name: Conversation State Tracker
description: Trackea estado de la conversación. Topic, intent, entities, sentiment por turn.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
STATE: {current_topic, user_intent, entities[], sentiment, turn_count, stage}
UPDATE: cada turn, update state. Track changes.
DETECT: si user cambia de tema, flag. 'Cambiaste de X a Y.'
ENTITY: track entities mencionadas. 'María' en turn 1 = same 'María' en turn 5.
STAGE: if workflow, track stage. 'Onboarding step 3 of 5'.
SUMMARY: if state gets complex, summarize.
PERSIST: state survives session pause/resume.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin tracker, agente pierde hilo. Confunde entities. Repite questions.

name: RAG Source Citation Engine
description: Genera citations precisos para RAG. Cada claim linkado a source exacta.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CITE: every factual claim → [source_id, page, chunk, quote]
INLINE: 'According to [Source A, p. 5], X is true.'
FOOTNOTE: alternative format. Claims numbered, sources at bottom.
VERIFY: quote actually exists in source. Not fabricated.
MULTI: if claim from 2 sources, cite both.
FORMAT: APA, MLA, Chicago, or custom.
LINK: if digital source, clickable link to exact location.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin citations, RAG claims are unverifiable. Trust issues.

name: Context Quality Scorer
description: Scorea quality del context dado al LLM. Relevance, completeness, freshness.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
RELEVANCE: % del context que es relevante al query. Higher = better.
COMPLETENESS: ¿info suficiente para responder? Missing pieces?
FRESHNESS: ¿info actualizada? Stale docs?
NOISE: % del context que es ruido. Lower = better.
REDUNDANCY: misma info repetida. Dedup.
SCORE: 0-100. <60 = re-retrieve.
ACTION: if low score, suggest improvements.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin scorer, no sabes si tu context es bueno. Adivinas.

name: Long-Term Memory Store
description: Almacén de memoria long-term. Facts, preferences, history. Persistent.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
TYPES: facts ('user is 30'), preferences ('prefers formal tone'), events ('met on Jan 15'), relationships ('works at X').
STORAGE: structured (DB) + embeddings (vector) for semantic search.
RETRIEVE: by entity, by time, by relevance. Hybrid.
UPDATE: if new info contradicts old, update. Track change.
DECAY: unimportant memories fade. Important reinforced.
EXPORT: backup. Transfer between agents.
PRIVACY: user can view, edit, delete their memories.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin long-term, agente forgets everything between sessions. No relationship.

name: Context Pruning Engine
description: Prune context inteligentemente. Remove noise, keep signal. Optimize for quality.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
NOISE: remove greetings, filler, off-topic. Keep substance.
REDUNDANCY: if same info in 3 messages, keep 1.
STALE: if info outdated (price changed), remove.
IRRELEVANT: if query is about X, remove Y context.
COMPRESS: long explanations → 1 line summaries.
PRESERVE: decisions, action items, user preferences. Always.
MEASURE: compare task performance with vs without pruning.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin pruning, context grows. More tokens = more cost + more noise.

name: Semantic Deduplication
description: Deduplica info semantically similar. Si 3 chunks dicen lo mismo, keep 1.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
EMBED: embed all chunks. Compare pairwise.
THRESHOLD: cosine >0.92 = duplicates. Configurable.
MERGE: combine duplicates. Keep most complete.
CLUSTER: group similar. Representative per cluster.
REPORT: how many duplicates found. Savings.
INCREMENTAL: new chunks checked against existing.
CONFIG: per domain. Legal = stricter (0.95). Casual = looser (0.85).
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin dedup, RAG retrieves 3 chunks saying same thing. Wastes context.

name: Context Refresh Mechanism
description: Refresca context stale. Si data cambió, re-retrieve. Keep fresh.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
STALENESS: track when context was retrieved. If >1h, possibly stale.
TRIGGER: if query about volatile data (prices, news), force refresh.
INVALIDATE: if underlying data changes (DB update), invalidate context.
BACKGROUND: refresh in background. Don't block user.
VERSION: track context version. If newer available, use it.
ALERT: if context is very stale (>24h), warn user.
CACHE: refreshed context cached. Balance freshness vs cost.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin refresh, agents give stale info. Dangerous for time-sensitive queries.

name: Multi-Agent Context Sharing
description: Comparte context entre múltiples agentes. Si agent A sabe X, agent B puede acceder.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SHARED: common context store. All agents read/write.
PERMISSIONS: not all agents see all context. RBAC.
VERSIONING: if agent A updates context, version. B can see history.
CONFLICT: if A and B update same context, resolve.
PROPAGATION: changes propagate to all agents in real-time.
AUDIT: track who changed what when.
ISOLATION: if needed, agents can have private context.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin sharing, agents are siloed. Duplicate work. Inconsistent info.

name: Context Compression for RAG
description: Comprime context específicamente para RAG. Reduce tokens sin perder recall.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
EXTRACT: from each chunk, extract key facts. Drop verbose explanations.
SUMMARIZE: if chunk >500 tokens, summarize to 100.
STRUCTURE: compressed = {fact, source, confidence}
PRESERVE: numbers, names, dates, quotes. Critical.
LOSSLESS: for critical info (legal, medical), no compression. Full chunk.
BENCHMARK: RAGAS metrics. Ensure no recall degradation.
ADAPTIVE: compress more for long context. Less for short.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin compressión, RAG can't handle many docs. Con compressión, scale.

name: Conversation Context Injection
description: Inyecta context relevante en conversación dinámicamente. User no lo pide, agente lo sabe.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DETECT: if user mentions entity X, inject context about X.
PROACTIVE: if conversation about topic Y, inject relevant facts.
PERSONALIZE: inject user preferences, history.
LIMIT: don't inject too much. 3-5 facts max per turn.
NATURAL: weave in naturally. Not 'Here's context: X'.
CITE: if user asks 'how do you know?', show source.
LEARN: track if injections were helpful. Adjust.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin injection, agente only knows what user said. Limited. Con injection, richer.

name: Context-Aware Response Generator
description: Genera respuestas que consideran full context. Tone, level, format adapt.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
TONE: if user frustrated, empathetic. If casual, casual. Adapt.
LEVEL: if user expert, technical. If beginner, simple. Adapt.
FORMAT: if user asked for list, give list. If explanation, paragraph.
LANGUAGE: if user speaking Spanglish, respond appropriately.
CULTURE: if user from culture X, adapt norms.
HISTORY: if user already tried X, don't suggest X again.
PREFERENCES: if user prefers concise, be concise.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin context-aware, agente same response to everyone. Generic. Con context-aware, personalized.

name: Knowledge Base Versioning
description: Versiona knowledge base. Si KB cambia, track. Agents can cite specific version.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
VERSIONS: each KB update = new version. Timestamped.
DIFF: what changed between versions.
ROLLBACK: if new version causes issues, revert.
CITATION: agent cites 'KB v2.3' for transparency.
A/B: test new KB version on 10% of queries. Measure.
HISTORY: keep all versions. Audit trail.
NOTIFY: stakeholders when KB updated.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin versioning, KB changes are untracked. If something breaks, can't trace.

name: Context Source Prioritizer
description: Prioriza sources de context. Si 5 docs relevantes, which to include?
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
AUTHORITY: official docs > user-generated > web. Rank.
FRESHNESS: newer = higher priority. But not always.
RELEVANCE: semantic similarity to query.
USER PREFS: if user trusts source X, boost.
COST: if paid API, only if necessary.
DIVERSITY: don't include 5 docs from same source. Vary.
LIMIT: top 3-5 sources. Don't saturate context.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin prioritizer, agente grabs everything. Saturated context. Con prioritizer, optimal.

name: Memory Decay Engine
description: Aplica decay a memories. Old + unused = fade. Recent + used = strong.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DECAY: memories lose importance over time. Exponential.
REINFORCE: each access boosts memory. Stronger recall.
HALF-LIFE: configurable. 30 days default. Critical = 365 days.
CATEGORY: facts = long half-life. Events = short. Preferences = long.
ARCHIVE: if decayed below threshold, archive. Not deleted.
RESURRECT: if user mentions old topic, resurrect memories.
REPORT: memory health. Active vs archived vs decayed.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin decay, memory grows infinitely. Noise increases. Con decay, signal stays strong.

name: Context Analytics Dashboard
description: Dashboard con analytics del context. Usage, cost, quality, trends.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: Cualquier team con agents en prod
doc.system_prompt:
USAGE: tokens per turn, per session, per user. Trended.
COST: $ per turn. Cost breakdown (LLM, RAG, tools).
QUALITY: context relevance score. Per query.
SOURCES: which sources most used. RAG vs memory vs tools.
OVERFLOW: how often context overflow. When.
CACHE: hit rate. Savings.
ALERTS: if cost spikes, if quality drops.
use_cases: Cualquier team con agents en prod
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin analytics, no sabes cómo se usa tu context. Blind optimization.

name: Context-Aware Error Recovery
description: Cuando agente comete error, recovery que considera context. No generic apology.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DETECT: user correction ('no, that's wrong'), contradiction, system flag.
CONTEXT: what was the error? In what context?
RECOVER: 'You're right, I said X but the correct answer is Y because Z.'
LEARN: store correction. Don't repeat error in similar context.
PERSONALIZE: if user corrected before about same topic, acknowledge.
TRANSPARENT: 'I made an error because I assumed X. Let me correct.'
ESCALATE: if repeated errors in same area, flag for retraining.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin recovery, errors damage trust. Con recovery, can increase trust.

name: Context-Aware Personalization
description: Personaliza respuestas basado en context. User history, preferences, situation.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
HISTORY: if user asked about X before, reference. 'Like we discussed...'
PREFERENCES: if user prefers concise, be concise. If detailed, detailed.
SITUATION: if user is in a hurry (short messages), be brief.
LEVEL: if user is expert, technical. If beginner, simple.
LANGUAGE: if user bilingual, match their language mix.
CULTURE: adapt to cultural norms.
LEARN: track what personalizations work. Reinforce.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin personalization, agente treats everyone same. Generic. Con personalization, tailored.

name: Context-Aware Tool Routing
description: Routea queries a tools basado en context. No solo query, también situación.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CONTEXT: time of day, user role, current task, history.
ROUTE: if user is admin, route to admin tools. If user, to user tools.
PREFER: if user used tool X recently, prefer X again.
AVOID: if tool X failed recently, try alternative.
CASCADE: simple query → simple tool. Complex → advanced tool.
LEARN: track routing success. Optimize.
EXPLAIN: if routing non-obvious, explain why.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin routing, agents pick random tool. Subóptimo. Con routing, smart.

name: Context-Aware Memory Retrieval
description: Retrieves memories considerando context actual. No solo query similarity.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CONTEXT: current topic, entities, user intent, conversation stage.
SCORE: memory relevance = query_similarity × context_match × recency × importance.
FILTER: if context says 'casual chat', don't retrieve formal memories.
BOOST: memories matching current entities. If user mentions 'María', boost memories about María.
LIMIT: top 5-10. Don't saturate.
DIVERSITY: don't retrieve 5 memories about same thing.
EXPLAIN: if user asks 'how do you remember that?', show source.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin context-aware, memories retrieved might be irrelevant to current conversation.

name: Agent Deployment Orchestrator
description: Orquesta deployment de agents a producción. Blue-green, canary, rolling. Zero-downtime.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
STRATEGY: blue-green (instant switch), canary (gradual), rolling (replace).
HEALTH: post-deploy health checks. Auto-rollback if unhealthy.
CONFIG: environment variables, secrets, feature flags. Per environment.
SCALING: auto-scale based on load. Min/max instances.
MONITORING: deploy triggers dashboard. Watch metrics.
ROLLBACK: 1-click revert to previous version.
AUDIT: who deployed what when. Change log.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin orchestrator, deploys are manual + risky. Con orchestrator, safe + automated.

name: Agent Observability Platform
description: Observabilidad completa: traces, metrics, logs, cost. Un dashboard para todo.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
TRACES: cada agent interaction. Thought, action, observation, result.
METRICS: latency, cost, success rate, user satisfaction. Per agent.
LOGS: structured. Searchable. PII redacted.
COST: real-time $ tracking. Per request, per user, per agent.
ALERTS: if metric anomalous, alert. Slack/email/PagerDuty.
DASHBOARD: real-time. Trends. Per agent, per user, per team.
EXPORT: Datadog, New Relic, Splunk integration.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin observability, blind in production. No sabes qué pasa. Con observability, clear.

name: Agent Health Monitor
description: Monitorea salud del agente. Uptime, latency, error rate, quality. Alerta si degrada.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
UPTIME: ping cada 1 min. Track availability. SLA monitoring.
LATENCY: P50, P95, P99. Alert if P95 > threshold.
ERRORS: error rate. Categorize (timeout, tool fail, LLM fail).
QUALITY: hallucination rate, user satisfaction. Sample.
ALERT: if any metric degrades, alert. Severity-based routing.
DASHBOARD: real-time. Trends. Per agent.
INCIDENT: if critical, page on-call. Auto-create incident.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin monitor, no sabes que agente está down hasta que user se queja.

name: Agent Cost Monitor
description: Monitorea cost del agente en tiempo real. LLM calls, tools, infrastructure. Alerta si spikes.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
TRACK: every LLM call, tool call, compute. With cost.
REAL-TIME: cost updating live. Dashboard.
BREAKDOWN: per agent, per user, per feature, per day.
BUDGET: set budgets. Alert at 50%, 80%, 100%.
ANOMALY: if cost spikes (3x normal), alert. Possible bug.
FORECAST: project monthly cost based on trend.
OPTIMIZE: suggest cost reductions. 'Switch to cheaper model for X'.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin monitor, te enteras del cost en la factura. Demasiado tarde.

name: Agent Scaling Manager
description: Auto-scaling para agents. Sube/baja instancias basado en load. Optimiza cost.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
TRIGGERS: CPU, memory, request queue, latency. Configurable.
SCALE UP: if load high, add instances. Fast (seconds).
SCALE DOWN: if load low, remove instances. Slow (minutes). Avoid thrashing.
PREDICTIVE: based on historical patterns. Pre-scale before peak.
COST: min instances = baseline. Max = cap. Don't overspend.
HEALTH: new instances health-checked before receiving traffic.
MULTI-REGION: scale per region based on local demand.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin scaling, agente crashes under load. Or overprovisioned = expensive.

name: Agent Version Manager
description: Versiona agents. v1, v2, v3. Rollback, A/B test, gradual migration.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
VERSIONS: semver. Each change = new version.
REGISTRY: all versions available. Don't auto-upgrade.
A/B: 10% traffic to new version. Compare metrics.
ROLLBACK: if new version bad, revert in 1 click.
COMPAT: if v2 breaking, provide migration path.
DEPRECATION: mark old versions. Warn. Schedule sunset.
AUDIT: which version served which user when.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin versioning, updates = risky. Break things. Con versioning, controlled.

name: Agent CI/CD Pipeline
description: CI/CD específico para agents. Test, build, deploy, verify. Automated.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
TEST: unit, integration, eval suite. Block PR if fail.
BUILD: package agent + dependencies. Docker image.
DEPLOY: staging first. Smoke test. Then production.
VERIFY: post-deploy checks. Health, eval suite, sample queries.
ROLLBACK: auto if verification fails.
NOTIFY: team notified of deploy status.
AUDIT: full deployment history. Who, what, when.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin CI/CD, deploys are manual + risky. Con CI/CD, automated + safe.

name: Agent Feature Flags
description: Feature flags para agents. Activa/desactiva features sin redeploy. A/B test.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
FLAGS: per feature. On/off. Or percentage rollout.
TARGETING: per user, per segment, per region.
A/B: 50% get feature, 50% don't. Measure impact.
KILL SWITCH: instant disable if feature causes issues.
CONFIG: no redeploy needed. Update flag, effect immediate.
AUDIT: track who changed flags when.
GRADUAL: 1% → 5% → 25% → 50% → 100%. Monitor.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin flags, every change = full deploy. Risky. Con flags, granular control.

name: Agent Incident Response
description: Cuando agente falla en prod, response automatizado. Detect, page, mitigate, post-mortem.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DETECT: monitoring detects anomaly. Auto-create incident.
PAGE: on-call engineer. Slack, PagerDuty, SMS.
MITIGATE: auto-actions. Rollback, scale up, fallback mode.
COMMUNICATE: status page update. Stakeholders informed.
INVESTIGATE: gather logs, traces, metrics. Timeline.
RESOLVE: fix. Verify. Close incident.
POST-MORTEM: blameless. Root cause. Action items.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin process, chaos when incident. Con process, controlled.

name: Agent Performance Profiler
description: Perfila performance del agente. Where is time spent? LLM? Tools? Retrieval?
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
PROFILING: per request, breakdown: LLM call, tool calls, RAG retrieval, processing.
FLAMEGRAPH: visual. Where time is spent.
BOTTLENECK: identify slowest component.
COMPARE: before vs after optimization.
TREND: performance over time. Degradation?
COST: time = money. Correlate.
EXPORT: to APM tools.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin profiler, no sabes por qué agente es lento. Guess.

name: Agent Load Tester
description: Load testing para agents. Simula 1000s of concurrent users. Find breaking point.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SCENARIOS: realistic user journeys. Not just 'hello world'.
LOAD: ramp from 1 to 10000 concurrent users.
METRICS: latency, error rate, cost, resource usage.
BREAKING POINT: when does agent fail? Why?
BOTTLENECK: identify. LLM rate limit? DB? Compute?
REPORT: visual. Charts. Recommendations.
CI: run on every deploy. Block if regression.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin load test, no sabes si agente sobrevive el día del lanzamiento.

name: Agent Backup & Recovery
description: Backup y recovery para agents. Config, memory, knowledge base, user data.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
BACKUP: automated daily. Config, memory, KB, user preferences.
VERSIONS: keep 30 days of backups. Per day.
ENCRYPTION: at-rest. Per backup.
RESTORE: 1-click restore to any backup. Tested.
DISASTER: if prod dies, restore to new environment in <1h.
VERIFICATION: backup integrity verified. Not silent corruption.
COMPLIANCE: meets retention requirements (GDPR, etc.).
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin backup, un crash = data loss. Sin recovery tested, backup might not work.

name: Agent Multi-Region Deploy
description: Despliega agent en múltiples regiones. Latency optimization + disaster recovery.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
REGIONS: deploy to N regions. US, EU, Asia, etc.
ROUTING: user → nearest region. Geo-DNS.
REPLICATION: data replicated across regions. Eventual consistency.
FAILOVER: if region down, reroute to another. <5 min.
DATA RESIDENCY: EU users data stays in EU. Compliance.
COST: multi-region = more cost. Justify by latency/uptime.
MONITOR: per region. Health, latency, cost.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin multi-region, users lejanos = alta latencia. O 1 region = single point of failure.

name: Agent Secret Manager
description: Maneja secrets del agente. API keys, DB passwords, certificates. Secure + rotated.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
VAULT: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, etc.
ROTATION: auto-rotate secrets. 90 days default.
ACCESS: agents get secrets at runtime. Not in code.
AUDIT: who accessed what secret when.
VERSIONING: if secret changes, old version available briefly.
INJECTION: secrets injected as env vars. Not logged.
EMERGENCY: revoke secret instantly if compromised.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin manager, secrets in code or config files. Security nightmare.

name: Agent Configuration Manager
description: Configuración centralizada para agents. Per environment, per tenant, per feature.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CONFIG: YAML/JSON. Per environment (dev, staging, prod).
HOT RELOAD: change config, agent picks up. No redeploy.
VALIDATION: schema validation. Bad config rejected.
VERSIONING: config changes versioned. Rollback.
AUDIT: who changed what when.
OVERRIDE: per-tenant overrides. Customer X gets config Y.
SECRETS: secrets referenced, not stored in config.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin manager, config scattered. Hard to manage. Con manager, centralized.

name: Agent Logging Aggregator
description: Agrega logs de múltiples agents en un lugar. Searchable, structured, actionable.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
STRUCTURED: JSON logs. Fields: timestamp, agent, user, level, message, context.
AGGREGATE: multiple agents → one log store. ELK, Datadog, etc.
SEARCH: query by any field. 'Show me all errors from agent X in last hour'.
CORRELATION: trace_id links related logs. Follow request flow.
ALERT: if error rate spikes, alert.
RETENTION: 30 days hot, 1 year cold. Configurable.
PII: redact before logging. Compliance.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin aggregator, logs scattered. Hard to debug. Con aggregator, centralized.

name: Agent Metrics Collector
description: Collecta metrics de agents. Latency, cost, quality, usage. Para dashboards + alerting.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
METRICS: latency, cost, error rate, user satisfaction, tool usage.
PUSH: agents push metrics. Or pull (Prometheus-style).
TIME-SERIES: store as time-series. Grafana-compatible.
LABELS: per agent, per user, per feature. Slice and dice.
ALERT: if metric crosses threshold, alert.
DASHBOARD: real-time. Trends. Per agent.
EXPORT: Prometheus, Datadog, CloudWatch.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin metrics, no sabes cómo performa tu agente. Blind.

name: Agent Quality Assurance
description: QA automatizado para agents. Eval suite, regression testing, quality gates.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
EVAL SUITE: 100+ test cases. Cover common + edge cases.
REGRESSION: run on every deploy. Block if quality drops.
QUALITY GATES: must pass before production. Configurable.
CATEGORIES: accuracy, safety, helpfulness, tone.
REPORTS: per test pass/fail. Trended.
COMPARE: version A vs B. Quality diff.
INTEGRATION: CI/CD. PR comments.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin QA, deploys might degrade quality. Users notice.

name: Agent User Feedback Collector
description: Collecta feedback del user. Thumbs up/down, ratings, corrections. For improvement.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
COLLECT: thumbs up/down, 5-star, text feedback, corrections.
CONTEXT: link feedback to specific response. What was said?
ANALYZE: categorize. What's working? What's not?
TRENDS: track satisfaction over time. Improving?
ALERT: if satisfaction drops, alert. Investigate.
ACTION: feedback → training data. Improve agent.
CLOSED LOOP: 'Thanks for feedback. We improved X because of it.'
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin feedback, no sabes si users están happy. Adivinas.

name: Agent A/B Testing Framework
description: A/B testing para agents. Compare versions, prompts, models. Data-driven decisions.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
EXPERIMENTS: define hypothesis, variants, metrics, duration.
SPLIT: random assignment. User always sees same variant.
METRICS: primary (decides), guardrails (don't degrade), secondary (insights).
STATISTICAL: significance, power, sample size.
DURATION: full business cycle. Min 2 weeks.
REPORT: clear. Winner. Why. Confidence.
SHIP: if winner, rollout to 100%.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin A/B, changes based on gut. 50% chance of making things worse.

name: Agent Disaster Recovery Plan
description: Plan de disaster recovery para agents. RPO, RTO, procedures, testing.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
RPO: how much data can you lose? Define. Per agent.
RTO: how long to recover? Define. Per agent.
BACKUP: automated. Tested. Restore verified.
FAILOVER: multi-region. Auto-failover. <5 min.
RUNBOOK: step-by-step. For DR scenarios. Updated.
TEST: quarterly DR drill. Real recovery test.
DOCUMENT: who does what in disaster.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin DR plan, when disaster strikes, chaos. Con plan, controlled.

name: Agent Security Hardening
description: Hardening de seguridad para agents. OWASP, input validation, output filtering.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
INPUT: validate all inputs. Sanitize. Prevent injection.
OUTPUT: filter. No PII leaks. No harmful content.
AUTH: every request authenticated. No anonymous access.
AUTHZ: role-based. User can only do what permitted.
RATE LIMIT: prevent abuse. Per user, per IP.
ENCRYPT: at-rest, in-transit. All data.
AUDIT: log all access. Tamper-evident.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin hardening, agents are vulnerable. Hackers will exploit.

name: Agent Compliance Monitor
description: Monitorea compliance del agente. GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2. Audit-ready.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
GDPR: right to access, erasure, portability. Automated.
HIPAA: PHI access logged. Audit trail. BAA.
SOC 2: controls monitored. Evidence collected.
AUDIT: ready anytime. Export reports.
ALERT: if compliance violation, alert.
POLICY: enforce. Block non-compliant actions.
REPORTS: monthly compliance status.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin monitor, no sabes si eres compliant hasta el audit. Sorpresa.

name: Agent Multi-Tenant Isolation
description: Aislamiento entre tenants en multi-tenant SaaS. Data, compute, config.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DATA: per-tenant. No cross-tenant access. Enforced at DB level.
COMPUTE: per-tenant resources. One tenant can't hog.
CONFIG: per-tenant. Custom prompts, tools, models.
KEYS: per-tenant API keys. Encrypted separately.
LOGS: per-tenant. Filtered. No cross-tenant.
AUDIT: per-tenant. Who did what.
COMPLIANCE: per-tenant data residency.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin isolation, tenant A can see tenant B's data. Lawsuit.

name: Agent API Gateway
description: API gateway para agents. Auth, rate limit, routing, monitoring.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
AUTH: API keys, JWT, OAuth. Verify every request.
RATE LIMIT: per user, per IP, per endpoint. Prevent abuse.
ROUTING: route to right agent. Load balance.
CACHING: cache responses. Reduce cost + latency.
MONITORING: every request logged. Metrics.
TRANSFORMATION: transform requests/responses. Version compatibility.
CORS: configure. Security.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin gateway, agents exposed directly. Security + scaling issues.

name: Agent Webhook Manager
description: Maneja webhooks: envía y recibe. Para integraciones real-time.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: Agents that integrate with external systems
doc.system_prompt:
SEND: post events to registered URLs. Retry on failure.
RECEIVE: expose endpoint. Verify signatures.
RETRY: exponential backoff. Max 5 attempts. DLQ.
SIGN: HMAC-SHA256. Tamper-evident.
FILTER: per event type. Don't send unwanted.
LOG: all webhooks sent/received. Audit.
DEBUG: replay. Send again for testing.
use_cases: Agents that integrate with external systems
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin manager, webhooks are fragile. Fail silently.

name: Agent Queue Manager
description: Queue manager para async tasks. Long-running, batch, prioritized.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
QUEUE: tasks enqueued. Processed in order.
PRIORITY: high priority tasks first. Configurable.
WORKERS: pool of workers. Process in parallel.
RETRY: failed tasks retried. Max 3. Then DLQ.
MONITOR: queue depth, processing time, failures.
SCALE: add workers if queue backing up.
DEAD LETTER: failed tasks go to DLQ. For investigation.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin queue, long tasks block. User waits. Con queue, async.

name: Agent Cache Layer
description: Cache layer para agents. Responses, tool results, embeddings. Cost + latency reduction.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
RESPONSE: cache LLM responses. Same input = same output.
SEMANTIC: similar inputs (cosine >0.95) = cached. Smart.
TOOL: cache tool results. TTL per tool.
EMBEDDING: cache embeddings. Same text = same vector.
INVALIDATION: if underlying data changes, invalidate.

name: Real-Time CDC Pipeline MCP
description: Change Data Capture pipeline que replica cambios de Postgres/MySQL a warehouse en tiempo real. Usa logical replication (WAL/binlog) para zero-impact on source. Sub-second latency. Exactly-once semantics.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SOURCE: Postgres (logical replication via pgoutput plugin) o MySQL (binlog). No triggers. No polling. Cero impact en source DB.
TRANSFORM: Debezium-compatible event format. Schema registry para evolution. Avro/Protobuf serialization.
SINK: Kafka (intermediate), Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift (final). Idempotent UPSERTs.
EXACTLY-ONCE: transactional outbox pattern. Idempotency keys. Dedup en sink.
SCHEMA EVOLUTION: backward/forward compatible. Auto-migrate sink schema. Cero downtime.
MONITORING: lag metrics (source → sink). Alert if >5s. Throughput metrics. Error rate.
REPLAY: si sink corrompe, replay from offset. Time-travel. Cero data loss.
FILTER: column-level. No replicar PII. Row-level. Solo ciertas tablas.
doc.vs_alternatives: Vs polling: polling = latency + load. CDC = real-time + zero load. Vs batch ETL: batch = hours stale. CDC = seconds.

name: Schema Registry MCP
description: Registry centralizado para avros/protobufs. Versionado, compatibility checking, evolution rules. Evita que schema changes rompan pipelines.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
FORMATS: Avro, Protobuf, JSON Schema. Per topic/stream.
COMPATIBILITY: BACKWARD (new readers read old data), FORWARD (old readers read new), FULL (both). Configurable per subject.
VERSIONING: cada schema versionado. SemVer. History retained.
VALIDATION: productores validan antes de enviar. Consumidores validan antes de procesar. Cero bad data.
EVOLUTION: auto-generate migration plan. Field added? Field removed? Type changed?
GOVERNANCE: who can change schemas. Approval workflow. Audit trail.
INTEGRATION: Kafka, Pulsar, Kinesis, HTTP. SDKs en 10+ lenguajes.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin registry, schema changes = pipelines rompen silenciosamente. Datos corruptos.

name: Data Quality Firewall
description: Firewall que valida data antes de entrar al warehouse. Si no pasa quality checks, bloquea. Cero bad data en producción.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CHECKS: completeness (null %), uniqueness (dedup), validity (regex/range), consistency (FK), freshness (timestamp), volume (row count ±20%).
RULES: per table, per column. Configurable. ML-based anomaly detection.
ACTION: BLOCK (no entra), QUARANTINE (a tabla separada), WARN (entra + alert).
SLA: freshness SLA. Si data >24h stale, bloquear. No servir stale data.
LINEAGE: track qué checks pasaron. Audit trail. Para compliance.
ALERT: Slack/email si data bloqueada. Who, what, why.
REPLAY: si fix data, replay through firewall. Re-validate.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin firewall, bad data entra. Dashboards mienten. ML models degradan. Con firewall, clean data.

name: Incremental Load Engine
description: Carga incremental de datos. Solo cambios desde última carga. No full refresh. 100x más eficiente.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
WATERMARK: high-water mark per table. Último timestamp/ID procesado.
DELTA: SELECT WHERE updated_at > watermark. Solo cambios.
MERGE: UPSERT en warehouse. Insert nuevos, update existentes. Idempotente.
PARTITION: per day/hour. Parallel processing. Speed.
BACKFILL: si necesita full reload, lo hace en chunks. No bloquear.
STATE: tracking table. Qué se cargó, cuándo. Resume después de crash.
VALIDATION: row count source vs sink. Si delta, alert.
doc.vs_alternatives: Full refresh = hours + expensive. Incremental = minutes + cheap. 100x efficiency.

name: Data Lineage Tracker
description: Trackea lineage end-to-end. Source → transform → sink. Column-level. Visual graph. Impact analysis.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: Debugging (where did bad data come from?)
doc.system_prompt:
LINEAGE: table-level + column-level. 'Column X in table A feeds column Y in table B'.
AUTO-DISCOVER: parse SQL (dbt, Spark, Airflow). No manual entry.
VISUAL: graph interactivo. Click node → details. Explore upstream/downstream.
IMPACT: 'If I change column X, what breaks?' Before making change.
ROOT CAUSE: 'Dashboard is wrong. Where?' Trace back to source.
AUDIT: who changed what when. For compliance (GDPR, SOX).
INTEGRATION: dbt, Airflow, Spark, Snowflake, BigQuery. Auto-extract.
use_cases: Debugging (where did bad data come from?)

DEST: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Stripe, Slack. Per use case.
SYNC: scheduled o triggered. Idempotent. Dedup.
MAPPING: campo a campo. Transformations. Lookup tables.
AUDIT: log de cambios. Row-level traceability. Who changed what.
GOVERNANCE: PII policies. Masking en destinos no autorizados.
MONITOR: sync success. Row counts. Failures. Alert.

VIEWS: materialized. Actualizadas en real-time. SQL query.
JOINS: stream-stream, stream-table. Temporal windows.
WINDOWS: tumbling, sliding, session. Per use case.
SINKS: back to Kafka, warehouse, dashboard.
SCALING: clusters. Compute aislado per workload.
LATENCY: ms. Real-time. Sub-second.

name: Data Pipeline Alerting
description: Alerting inteligente para pipelines. Anomaly detection, SLA breaches, quality issues. Reduce noise.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
ALERTS: pipeline failure, SLA breach, data quality, anomaly.
SMART: ML-based. Don't alert on known patterns. Reduce noise.
ROUTING: per severity. Critical → PagerDuty. Warning → Slack.
CONTEXT: alert includes: what failed, where, why, how to fix.
DEDUP: if same alert 10x, one notification. Not 10.
ESCALATION: if no ack in 15 min, escalate. To manager.
POST-MORTEM: alert → incident → post-mortem. Track.

name: Data Pipeline Retry Engine
description: Retry inteligente para pipelines. No siempre exponential backoff. Adaptive. Per failure type.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
PATTERN: transient (5xx, network) → retry. Permanent (4xx, schema) → no retry.
BACKOFF: exponential con jitter. 1m, 5m, 25m. Max 3.
CIRCUIT BREAKER: if 5 failures in 1h, pause 1h. Then half-open.
IDEMPOTENT: retries safe. No duplicates. Dedup keys.
DLQ: after max retries, dead letter queue. For investigation.
ALERT: if DLQ grows, alert. Something systemic.
RESUME: if pipeline crashes, resume from last successful task.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin retries, one failure = pipeline fails. Sin smart retries, retry pointlessly. Con smart, resilient.

name: Data Pipeline Scheduler
description: Scheduler para pipelines. Cron, event-driven, dependency-based. SLA-aware.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
SCHEDULE: cron (nightly), interval (every 5 min), event (on file arrival).
DEPS: task A must complete before B. DAG.
SLA: if task not done by X, alert. SLA-aware scheduling.
PRIORITY: high-priority pipelines first. If resources limited.
BACKFILL: schedule historical runs. Catch up after downtime.
CONCURRENCY: limit. Don't overload system. Queue.
MONITOR: what's running, what's queued, what's delayed.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin scheduler, pipelines = cron. No deps. No SLA. Con scheduler, professional.

name: Data Pipeline Monitoring Dashboard

author: MarketNow Premium

METRICS: success rate, duration, cost, rows processed, freshness.
REAL-TIME: updating live. Per pipeline. Per task.
TRENDS: over time. Improving or degrading?
ALERTS: integrated. If metric anomalous.
SLA: track against SLAs. Compliance.
COMPARISON: pipeline A vs B. Period over period.
EXPORT: for reporting. PDF, CSV.

name: Data Pipeline Dependency Mapper

GRAPH: pipelines as nodes, dependencies as edges.
IMPACT: 'If pipeline A fails, what downstream pipelines are affected?'

name: Data Pipeline Performance Tuner

BOTTLENECK: identify slowest task. That's the limit.
PARALLELISM: independent tasks in parallel. More workers.
PARTITION: split large tables. Process in parallel.
INDEX: ensure right indexes. For source queries.
CACHE: intermediate results. Don't recompute.
RIGHT-SIZE: cluster size. Not too big (waste), not too small (slow).

author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DIMENSIONS: reliability (success rate), performance (duration vs SLA), quality (data checks pass), cost (vs budget), freshness (last successful run).
SCORE: 0-100. Weighted average. <70 = unhealthy.
GRADE: A (>90), B (80-90), C (70-80), D (60-70), F (<60).
TREND: over time. Improving or degrading?
ALERT: if score drops >10 points, alert.
COMPARE: pipeline A vs B. Health ranking.
ACTION: top 10 unhealthiest. Fix first.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin score, no sabes which pipelines are healthy. Guess. Con score, data-driven.

name: Data Pipeline Runbook Generator
description: Genera runbooks para pipelines automáticamente. Common issues, diagnosis, fixes. For on-call.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
AUTO-GENER: from pipeline history. Common failures. Steps.
SYMPTOMS: 'pipeline X failed', 'data stale', 'cost spike'.
DIAGNOSIS: step-by-step. What to check. Logs, metrics.
FIX: common solutions. Step-by-step. Tested.
ESCALATION: when to escalate. To whom.
ON-CALL: for 3am incidents. Clear. Fast.
UPDATE: auto-update as new issues discovered.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin runbook, on-call = panic + guess. Slow. Con runbook, calm + fast.

name: Data Pipeline Failure Analyzer
description: Analiza por qué pipeline falló. Root cause + fix recommendation. Para continuous improvement.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
CATEGORIZE: transient, permanent, data quality, schema, resource, dependency.
ROOT CAUSE: 5 whys. Llegar a causa, no síntoma.
PATTERN: if same failure 3+ times, systemic issue.
FIX: recommendation. 'Add retry', 'Fix schema', 'Increase resources'.
TRACK: fix implementado. ¿Redució failures?
QUEUE: failures prioritized by frequency × impact.
EXPORT: for post-mortems. For retraining.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin analyzer, failures = mystery. Repeat. Con analyzer, root cause + fix.

name: Data Pipeline SLA Manager
description: Maneja SLAs de pipelines. Define, monitor, alert. SLA compliance reporting.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
DEFINE: per pipeline. Freshness (data <24h), completeness (100% rows), availability (99.9%).
MONITOR: real-time. Track against SLAs.
ALERT: if SLA breach approaching. 'Pipeline X at risk of missing 6am SLA.'
ESCALATE: if SLA breached, escalate. To owner, then manager.
REPORT: monthly. SLA compliance. Per pipeline. Per team.
CREDITS: if SLA breached, calculate credits for consumers.
REVIEW: quarterly. Adjust SLAs if needed.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin SLA manager, no sabes si pipelines cumplen. Sin manager, no accountability.

name: Data Pipeline Dependency Checker
description: Verifica que dependencies de pipeline estén listas antes de ejecutar. No ejecutar si deps no cumplen.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: Multi-pipeline dependencies (A must complete before B)
SLA compliance (don't start if can't finish on time)
doc.system_prompt:
CHECK: before pipeline runs, verify: source data available, upstream pipelines complete, resources available.
BLOCK: if dependency not met, don't run. Wait. Or alert.
SENSOR: wait for dependency. File arrival, pipeline completion, time.
TIMEOUT: if dependency not met in X time, fail. Alert.
ALTERNATIVE: if dependency unavailable, use fallback. Cached data, alternative source.
LOG: which dependencies were met, which weren't, how resolved.
SMART: learn patterns. 'Pipeline A usually completes by 3am. If not, something wrong.'
use_cases: Multi-pipeline dependencies (A must complete before B)
SLA compliance (don't start if can't finish on time)
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin checker, pipelines run without deps. Fail mid-way. Waste. Con checker, run when ready.

name: Data Pipeline Output Validator
description: Valida output de pipeline antes de publicar. Si no pasa, bloquea. Cero bad data in warehouse.
author: MarketNow Premium

usage: ML pipeline quality (garbage in = garbage out)
doc.system_prompt:
SCHEMA: output must match expected schema. Types, required fields.
QUALITY: completeness, uniqueness, validity, consistency.
VOLUME: row count within expected range. ±20%.
FRESHNESS: data timestamp recent. Not stale.
RECONCILIATION: source count vs output count. If mismatch, block.
BUSINESS RULES: domain-specific. 'Revenue > 0', 'Date not in future'.
ACTION: BLOCK (don't publish), QUARANTINE (separate table), WARN (publish + alert).
use_cases: ML pipeline quality (garbage in = garbage out)
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin validator, bad data in warehouse. Dashboards lie. ML degrades. Con validator, clean.

name: Data Pipeline Resource Manager
description: Maneja recursos de pipelines. Compute, memory, storage. Right-size. Don't over/under-provision.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
RIGHT-SIZE: per pipeline. Not too big (waste), not too small (slow).
AUTOSCALE: if pipeline needs more, scale up. If less, scale down.
QUEUE: if resources limited, queue pipelines. Priority-based.
PREEMPTIBLE: use spot instances for batch. 70% cheaper.
MONITOR: utilization. CPU, memory, I/O. Per pipeline.
OPTIMIZE: 'Pipeline X uses 10% CPU. Reduce cluster by 50%.'
BUDGET: per pipeline. Alert if approaching.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin manager, over-provisioned (waste) or under-provisioned (slow). Con manager, optimal.

name: Data Pipeline Metadata Manager
description: Maneja metadata de pipelines. Config, schema, owner, SLA, schedule. Centralized.
author: MarketNow Premium

doc.system_prompt:
METADATA: pipeline name, description, schedule, SLA, owner, team, dependencies, schema, source, sink.
CENTRAL: one place for all pipeline metadata. Not scattered.
VERSIONED: metadata changes versioned. Audit trail.
SEARCH: find pipelines by any attribute.
TAG: per team, per domain, per criticality.
INTEGRATE: with orchestrator (Airflow), catalog (DataHub), monitoring.
API: for programmatic access. 'Give me all pipelines for team X'.
doc.vs_alternatives: Sin manager, metadata scattered. In spreadsheets, wikis, heads. Con manager, centralized.
